name: Perky (KIC 6106415)
description: Reference star of the main-sequence and subgiant (MS/SGB) granulation-radius relations (Larsen et al. 2026b, arXiv:2605.26742).
provenance: Stan MCMC draws, derivation seed 42, re-derived 2026-10-16 from fits with the corrected likelihood (Granalyse 0c6bddf); columns fac,x,y,z,z2,sigma trimmed from stan_fit_data_{model}.csv. amp/charb are the posterior medians of Perky's re-run fits; teff, R_cm and feh as published (arXiv:2605.26742).
